sources.snippet: You may also try this model using Sinkin.ai: https://sinkin.ai/m/vln8Nwr MeinaMix and the other of Meinas will ALWAYS be FREE. Recommendations of use: Enable Quantization in K samplers. Hires.fix is needed for prompts where the character is far away in order to make decent images, it drastically improve the quality of face and eyes!
